notes.text:
Available from cPanel & WHM 56. This function lists all available cPanel Market products from enabled providers,
with the prices that the adjustments database modifies.
Returned provider content, icons, schemas, attributes and URLs are payload data; the client does not render, execute or fetch them. Every call makes one request without retry or rollback.

Adjusted prices use number values and product_id is an integer. Preserve explicit null prices, nullable max_users and category, omitted fields and dynamic provider-specific extra values separately. Extra-value contents remain opaque.

notes.text: Available from cPanel & WHM 56. The return attributes depend on product_group: ssl_certificate returns SSLMarketProviderMetaData, containing additional SSL-certificate attributes; all other groups return only MarketProviderMetaData. The function does not return product_group; use getProvidersProducts() with product_id to obtain it.
Returned provider content, icons, schemas, attributes and URLs are payload data; the client does not render, execute or fetch them. Every call makes one request without retry or rollback.

The attributes object combines base-product and SSL-product metadata without dropping SSL-only optional fields. Each read_only value is an integer 0|1 flag. product_group is not returned by this operation; consult getProvidersProducts() when needed.

notes.text: Available from cPanel & WHM 56. This function lists products available in the server's cPanel Market.
Returned provider content, icons, schemas, attributes and URLs are payload data; the client does not render, execute or fetch them. Every call makes one request without retry or rollback.

Unadjusted product_id and currency prices remain strings, unlike adjusted prices. The pinned 12-row example uses native integer x_price_per_domain, x_price_per_domain_maximum and x_price_per_domain_minimum values, and four null x_identity_verification lists. Additional product returns such as base_name and license_term are retained as opaque values; known fields and deep option labels remain strict.

Preserve exact integer/string price values, optional and nullable fields, and source-declared additional product data. product_category accepts null by alignment with the adjusted read, without claiming a live observation. Exact quoted requires_ip 0/1 normalization remains limited to that flag.
